need_details.label: Mapping complex source data to OMOP
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to map complex source data such as combination drugs, clinical trial instruments, survey concepts, family history, radiotherapy and curated national datasets into OMOP without losing meaning.
need_details.why_hard: OMOP guidance is unclear or non-standardized for these data types, and many data points map with lost granularity or not at all.

need_details.label: Representing genomic and omics data in OMOP
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to model NGS, omics, specimen-derived samples and unsupported CRF fields in OMOP using established patterns so genomic and clinical data can be analyzed together.
need_details.why_hard: OMOP lacks comprehensive omics standards and sample-level entities, OMOP Genomic has gaps, and practical guidance on variant representation and linkage at scale is limited.

need_details.label: Extending OMOP for AI and interoperability
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to store ML metadata in OMOP, bridge openEHR and OMOP, support negation for AI/ML, rely on formal artifact specifications, and use OMOP locally or through natural language.
need_details.why_hard: OHDSI has no established standards for these uses, OMOP's closed-world assumption conflicts with ML needs, and community focus is on federated research rather than local use.

need_details.label: Missing vocabulary concepts for source codes
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to map source codes such as ICD-O-3 combinations, ATC vaccines, rare disease codes, DRG and compounded drugs to OMOP standard concepts when the vocabulary lacks the needed concepts or relationships.
need_details.why_hard: Many source codes have no direct correspondence in the OMOP vocabularies, and Usagi cannot load custom vocabularies for fuzzy matching.

need_details.label: Expressing complex cohort logic in ATLAS
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to define cohorts in ATLAS that use episodes, patient ID lists, complex visit timing and negation logic, and to export the definitions as R code for regulatory submission.
need_details.why_hard: ATLAS lacks support for the Episode table and patient ID lists, its date and inclusion logic does not behave as expected, and it offers no way to extract R code packages.

need_details.label: Fixing OMOP vocabulary content defects
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to work with OMOP vocabularies that have correct, complete and stable concepts, including oncology TNM and nodal concepts, laterality, replacements for deprecated concepts and full NAACCR names.
need_details.why_hard: Vocabularies contain duplicate or truncated concepts, deprecate concepts without replacements, and lack laterality or grouped concepts, so mappings lose information and updates do not scale.

need_details.label: Running Achilles at scale
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to run Achilles reliably and with acceptable performance on large or non-standard OMOP databases and get all expected output tables.
need_details.why_hard: Runtimes vary widely or time out on large tables, analyses fail silently, multi-threading breaks, some dialects error, and functions are undocumented.

need_details.label: Installing ATLAS and WebAPI
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to install, build, upgrade and connect ATLAS and WebAPI reliably.
need_details.why_hard: Maven dependencies and the OHDSI Nexus repository are unavailable, download links are broken, and installation documentation for platforms like RHEL 9 is unclear.

need_details.label: Community coordination, training and documentation
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to coordinate collaborations, access up-to-date training materials and documentation, use working learning environments, and reach community resources.
need_details.why_hard: Training materials are not standardized, the Book of OHDSI is outdated, OHDSI documentation is sparse in Context7, and some resources such as the dashboard are offline.

need_details.label: Validating cohort comparability across sites
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to validate phenotype and cohort definitions, detect when sites encode concepts differently, and stratify cohort results by site in multi-site studies.
need_details.why_hard: Local encoding differences make results silently wrong without showing up in standard data quality tools, ATLAS cannot stratify by site, and phenotype validation tools are opaque.

need_details.label: Configuring ATLAS authentication and permissions
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to configure LDAP or Active Directory authentication and role-based permissions for ATLAS and WebAPI so authenticated users can use the modules they are assigned.
need_details.why_hard: Authentication fails despite correct configuration, role assignments do not grant access, errors are not logged, and documentation does not explain the setup.

need_details.label: CDM conventions for drugs, visits and types
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to know how to represent patient-reported and dispensed drugs, observation visit types, prescription proposals, unmapped values and visit-level costs in OMOP tables.
need_details.why_hard: OMOP guidance is unclear and community responses conflict, and some source records lack the dates needed to tell record types apart.

need_details.label: CDM conventions for observation periods and events
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to know the OMOP CDM conventions for representing derived ages, pregnancy episodes, incomplete questionnaire dates, stillbirths, migration events, observation periods and missed visits.
need_details.why_hard: Standard guidance is missing or unclear, for example on how observation_period relates to visit_occurrence and on records that lack an observation period.

need_details.label: Hosting and integrating HADES infrastructure
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to host OMOP databases and integrate HADES, Arachne and White Rabbit with their applications and cloud authentication.
need_details.why_hard: Security headers block embedding, versions mismatch between Arachne and HADES, Entra ID and SAML on Azure are unsupported or undocumented, and users lack database hosting experience.

need_details.label: Large measurement tables and duplicate rows
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to handle large MEASUREMENT and OBSERVATION tables efficiently, including fast data quality checks and correct handling of duplicate or expanded rows.
need_details.why_hard: DQD checks run for 40+ hours or freeze, memory settings are ignored, and multiple maps_to_value relationships or repeated samples produce duplicate rows.

need_details.label: OHDSI support for Trino, Spark and Doris
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to connect OHDSI tools to OMOP CDMs stored in Trino, Doris or Spark-backed platforms such as UK Biobank RAP.
need_details.why_hard: DatabaseConnector does not support these backends, and the Trino JDBC driver lacks batch query support.

need_details.label: Running DataQualityDashboard on SQL Server
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to connect DataQualityDashboard and DatabaseConnector to SQL Server and run and view DQD results and vocabulary loads without errors.
need_details.why_hard: Paths with spaces, JDBC and authentication errors, timeouts on large databases, a blank viewer, and hardcoded test thresholds break runs.

need_details.label: Modeling oncology episodes and treatments
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to represent oncology disease status, imaging findings, biopsies, screening phases, drug regimens and first-course treatments in OMOP tables, including the Episode table.
need_details.why_hard: It is unclear which tables and domains to use, current Episode concepts do not cover screening phases, and recording procedures in several tables risks duplication.

need_details.label: Richer, portable phenotype and concept definitions
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to build concept sets and phenotypes that use richer vocabulary relationships, access concepts and phenotypes programmatically, and share reproducible definitions.
need_details.why_hard: Circe concept set expressions support only hierarchy and limited mapping, Phenotype Library data must be downloaded manually, and published definitions lack implementation detail.

need_details.label: Reusable ETL pipelines into OMOP
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to convert sources such as CPRD, OpenMRS, microbiology data and Synthea into OMOP CDM using working, reusable ETL pipelines and clear specifications.
need_details.why_hard: ETL-CDMBuilder fails on CPRD, open-source pipelines for OpenMRS are missing, Metadata and microbiology specifications are vague, and ETL-Synthea exists only in R.

need_details.label: Representing clinical notes and NLP output
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to store clinical notes and NLP-extracted findings in NOTE and NOTE_NLP and link them to clinical event tables following clear conventions.
need_details.why_hard: It is unclear which type concepts to use, whether undated mentions belong in OBSERVATION, how to split report components into rows, and how to link NLP records to events.

need_details.label: Validating CDM compliance and structure
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to check OMOP compliance of CSVs, databases and generated SQL against authoritative CDM definitions using reliable validators.
need_details.why_hard: There is no clear single source of truth or formal SQL compliance standard, and cdmInspection and DataQualityDashboard crash or report confusing results.

need_details.label: Deploying Broadsea reliably
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to deploy Broadsea on Windows and AWS with pinned versions, working SAML or Azure authentication, and a usable local development workflow.
need_details.why_hard: Authentication guidance is missing, Windows secrets files fail, Docker Compose pulls unpinned latest versions, and code changes do not show up in containers.

need_details.label: CPT4 vocabulary processing and tool failures
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to process CPT4 vocabulary updates, track vocabulary versions programmatically, and run OHDSI result-export and example-study tools without errors.
need_details.why_hard: CPT4 processing crashes, runs out of memory or takes days, delta generation fails, and version names cannot be used as git tags.

need_details.label: Domain assignment for labs and measurements
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to decide the correct OMOP domain for lab tests, screening codes, qualitative results, hearing tests and scores when mapping source data.
need_details.why_hard: The boundary between Procedure, Observation and Measurement is ambiguous, LOINC answer relationships are incomplete, and vocabularies assign domains inconsistently.

need_details.label: Vocabulary release accuracy and maintenance
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to rely on accurate vocabulary release metadata, download historical vocabulary versions, and get ongoing maintenance of vocabularies such as UK dm+d.
need_details.why_hard: Athena returns wrong versions and dates, the backlog of foundational issues is frozen while central development is maintenance-focused, and dm+d has not been updated since May 2023.

need_details.label: Incorrect ICD-10 to SNOMED mappings
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to map ICD-10 codes to correctly specific SNOMED concepts that are reachable through CONCEPT_ANCESTOR so that cohorts capture all coded patients.
need_details.why_hard: Some ICD-10 codes map to overly broad or wrong concepts or are missing from the hierarchy, so hierarchy-based code lists miss thousands of patients.

need_details.label: Creating and maintaining ATLAS concept sets
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to create, save and maintain large numbers of concept sets in ATLAS, including after vocabulary and software updates.
need_details.why_hard: Vocabulary updates break existing concept sets, there is no clear way to automate creating thousands of them, and upgrades cause save and authorization errors without logs.

need_details.label: ATC to RxNorm drug mapping
need_details.need_statement: Community members need to map ATC drug classes to RxNorm concepts consistently for ETL, drug eras and class-level analysis.
need_details.why_hard: ATC-RxNorm relationships are inconsistent and come in several types, hierarchies are incomplete, ATC has ambiguous structure, and ingredient mapping loses dosage information.
